וְעַל כֵּן הוּא תָּמִיד מְחוּבָּר עִם יְהוּדָה,
Wherefore Dan is eternally paired alongside Judah,
דְּגַם דָּוִד אַדְמוֹנִי,
for David too was ruddy (admoni / wrathful),
רַק "עִם יְפֵה עֵינַיִם" (שְׁמוּאֵל א טז, יב)
save that he was "withal of beautiful eyes"—
אֵינוֹ הוֹרֵג אֶלָּא מִדַּעַת סַנְהֶדְרִין (בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה פָּרָשָׁה סג, ח),
he never executed except with the consent of the Sanhedrin (Bereishit Rabbah 63:8),
שֶׁרַק עַל יְדֵי כֹּחַ הַתְּשׁוּבָה
in that solely through the power of repentance
אָז נַעֲשָׂה הָרָע "טוֹב מְאֹד",
is the apparent evil transformed into 'very good',
עַד שֶׁ"יָדִין עַמּוֹ כְּאַחַד וְגוֹמֵר" – כִּמְיוּחָד שֶׁבַּשְּׁבָטִים (שָׁם פָּרָשָׁה צט, יא).
until "he shall judge his people as one, etc."—like the most distinguished of the tribes (Judah; Bereishit Rabbah 99:11).
וְזֶהוּ עַל יְדֵי נַפְתָּלִי שֶׁיָּלְדָה אַחַר כָּךְ,
And this was completed through Naphtali whom Bilhah bore subsequently,
דְּאָמְרָה: "נַפְתּוּלֵי אֱלֹהִים נִפְתַּלְתִּי עִם אֲחֹתִי" (בְּרֵאשִׁית ל, ח),
where Rachel declared: "With wrestling of God have I wrestled with my sister",
כְּפֵירוּשׁ מְנַחֵם שֶׁמֵּבִיא רַשִּׁ"י:
according to the interpretation of Menachem ben Saruk cited by Rashi:
לְשׁוֹן "צָמִיד פָּתִיל" וְחִבּוּר,
an expression of 'a covered lid bound with a cord' (tzamid patil) and union,
שֶׁנִּתְחַבְּרָה עִם אֲחוֹתָהּ לִהְיוֹת לְגוֹי אֶחָד.
in that she united with her sister to form a single undivided nation.
אַף שֶׁהוּא נִרְאֶה הֵיפֶךְ,
Even though outwardly they appear as polar opposites,
אֵינוֹ כָּעַמִּים דְּכָל אֶחָד יֵשׁ לוֹ כֹּחַ מְיוּחָד לֹא יִשְׁתַּנֶּה בּוֹ;
it is not like the nations, where each possesses an immutable vice from which it never changes;
מַה שֶּׁאֵין כֵּן יִשְׂרָאֵל אֵין לָהֶם שׁוּם כֹּחַ רַק מֵהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ
whereas Israel possess no independent power except from Hashem, blessed be He,
"הַנֹּתֵן [לְךָ] כֹּחַ לַעֲשׂוֹת חָיִל" (דְּבָרִים ח, יח),
Who "gives you power to get wealth/valor",
וְכָל כֹּחוֹתֵיהֶם בְּיָדָם לְהַטּוֹת כִּרְצוֹן הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ, אַף בְּהֵיפֶךְ מַמָּשׁ.
and all their traits are in their hands to steer toward Hashem's will, even unto their exact opposite.
וְעַל כֵּן תֵּיכֶף אַחַר דָּן שֶׁהוּא תֹּקֶף הַכַּעַס,
Wherefore immediately following Dan who represents intense wrath,
נוֹלַד מִמֶּנָּה נַפְתָּלִי "שְׂבַע רָצוֹן" (דְּבָרִים לג, כג)
there was born from Bilhah Naphtali who is "satisfied with favor/will",
שֶׁהוּא הֵיפֶךְ הַכַּעַס,
which is the absolute opposite of anger,
וּ"מָלֵא בִּרְכַּת ה'",
and "full with the blessing of Hashem",
כִּי: "שָׁם צִוָּה ה' אֶת הַבְּרָכָה" (תְּהִלִּים קלג, ג),
for: "there Hashem commanded the blessing",
כְּמַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב (סוֹף עֻקְצִין מִשְׁנָה יב):
as written (end of Uktzin 3:12):
לֹא מָצָא הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא כְּלִי מַחֲזִיק בְּרָכָה [לְיִשְׂרָאֵל] אֶלָּא שָׁלוֹם;
the Holy One found no vessel that holds blessing for Israel other than peace;
הַיְינוּ עַל יְדֵי הַהִתְאַחֲדוּת וְהִתְחַבְּרוּת,
namely through harmony, unification, and binding connection,
וּכְמַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב (בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה פָּרָשָׁה לח, ו)
and as written (Bereishit Rabbah 38:6)
עַל פָּסוּק: "חֲבוּר עֲצַבִּים אֶפְרָיִם, הַנַּח לוֹ" (הוֹשֵׁעַ ד, יז)
on the verse: "Ephraim is joined to idols; let him alone": –
מַה שּׁוֹרֶשׁ כֹּחַ נַפְתָּלִי שֶׁהוּא לְשׁוֹן חִבּוּר.
for this is the root-force of Naphtali which denotes intimate connection.
וְלֵוִי הוּא גַּם כֵּן לְשׁוֹן חִבּוּר,
And Levi is likewise an expression of connection (yillaveh),
וְהוּא הַמְחַבֵּר יִשְׂרָאֵל לַאֲבִיהֶם שֶׁבַּשָּׁמַיִם;
he being the one who binds Israel unto their Father in Heaven;
וְנַפְתָּלִי הוּא הַמְחַבֵּר יִשְׂרָאֵל זֶה לָזֶה,
while Naphtali is the one who binds the people of Israel one to another,
דְּ"אֶפְרַיִם לֹא יְקַנֵּא אֶת יְהוּדָה, וִיהוּדָה לֹא יָצוֹר אֶת אֶפְרָיִם" (יְשַׁעְיָה יא, יג),
so that "Ephraim shall not envy Judah, and Judah shall not vex Ephraim" (Isaiah 11:13),
דְּמִצַּד הָעוֹלָם הַזֶּה זַרְעָא דְּרָחֵל וְלֵאָה – ב' הֲפָכִים.
for from the perspective of this physical world, the seed of Rachel and Leah appear as two opposing extremes.
וִיהוּדָה – שֶׁמִּמֶּנּוּ הַנִּבְחָר מִזַּרְעָא דְּלֵאָה: מָשִׁיחַ בֶּן דָּוִד,
And Judah—from whom descends the chosen one from the seed of Leah: Mashiach ben David,
הוּא יִהְיֶה הַיָּחִיד שֶׁשָּׁב שֶׁמּוֹחֲלִין לוֹ וּלְכָל הָעוֹלָם כֻּלּוֹ (יוֹמָא פו:),
he will be the singular penitent on whose account forgiveness is granted to him and to the entire world (Yoma 86b),
עַד שֶׁ"יְבֻקַּשׁ אֶת עֲו‍ֹן יִשְׂרָאֵל... וְאֶת חַטֹּאת יְהוּדָה וְלֹא [תִמָּצֶאינָה]" וְגוֹמֵר (יִרְמְיָה נ, כ);
until "the iniquity of Israel shall be sought for... and the sins of Judah, and they shall not be found, etc." (Jeremiah 50:20);
כִּי יִתְלַבֵּן יִצְרָא דְּתַאֲוָה כְּמַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב לְמַעְלָה,
for the inclination of desire will be bleached and purified as written above,
דְּלֹא יִתְבַּטֵּל, רַק שֶׁיִּהְיֶה גַּם הוּא קָדוֹשׁ לֵאלֹהֵינוּ.
in that it will not be abolished, but will likewise become consecrated unto our God.
וְעַל זֶה אָמַר: "בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יִהְיֶה עַל מְצִלּוֹת הַסּוּס קֹדֶשׁ [לַה']" וְגוֹמֵר (זְכַרְיָה יד, כ);
And concerning this Scripture states: "In that day shall there be upon the bells of the horses: Holy unto Hashem, etc." (Zechariah 14:20);
סוּס מוֹרֶה זִמָּה, כְּמַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב בְּפֶרֶק עֵלוּ עוֹבְרִין (פְּסָחִים קיג:):
a horse signifies licentiousness, as written in chapter Elu Ovrin (Pesachim 113b):
דְּאוֹהֵב אֶת הַזִּמָּה,
that it loves licentiousness,
וּכְמַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב: "סוּסִים מְיֻזָּנִים [הָיוּ]" וְגוֹמֵר (יִרְמְיָה ה, ח);
and as it is written: "They were as well-fed horses, etc." (Jeremiah 5:8);
וְעַל כֵּן בְּמִצְרַיִם מְקוֹם הַזִּמָּה שָׁם מוֹצָא הַסּוּסִים,
and therefore in Egypt, the den of licentiousness, was the source of horses,
וְסוּס עַצְמוֹ מוֹרֶה זוּהֲמַת הַזִּמָּה שֶׁהִיא חֵלֶק הָאֻמּוֹת שֶׁמְּשׁוּקָּעִים בָּהּ בֶּאֱמֶת;
and the horse itself denotes the defilement of lust which is the intrinsic lot of the nations who are truly immersed in it;
וְעַל זֶה הֻזְהֲרוּ יִשְׂרָאֵל: "שֶׁלֹּא לְהַרְבּוֹת סוּס, לְבַל יָשִׁיב [אֶת הָעָם מִצְרַיְמָה]" וְגוֹמֵר (דְּבָרִים יז, טז).
and concerning this Israel were warned: not to multiply horses, lest he cause the people to return to Egypt, etc. (Deuteronomy 17:16).
רַק "מְצִלּוֹת" – שֶׁהוּא הַמֻּצָּל מִתַּאֲוָה זוֹ לְחֵלֶק יִשְׂרָאֵל,
Only 'metzilot' (bells/salvaged elements)—that which is rescued (mutzal) from this lust unto the portion of Israel,
זֶה יִהְיֶה קֹדֶשׁ;
this shall be consecrated as holy;
מַה שֶּׁאֵין כֵּן כֹּחַ כַּעַס וּרְצִיחָה
whereas the power of anger and bloodshed—
תַּכְלִית הַטּוֹב שֶׁבּוֹ שֶׁלְּכָךְ נִבְרָא, הוּא כְּדֵי לִמְחוֹת זֶרַע עֲמָלֵק,
the ultimate good within it for which it was created is to obliterate the seed of Amalek,
וְאַחַר כָּךְ יִתְבַּטֵּל כֹּחַ זֶה לְגַמְרֵי.
and afterward this destructive trait will be utterly abolished.
וְעַל כֵּן מָשִׁיחַ בֶּן יוֹסֵף,
And therefore Mashiach ben Yosef,
שֶׁהוּא יִהְיֶה הַמָּשִׁיחַ מִלְחָמָה נֶגֶד אֻמּוֹת הָעוֹלָם,
who will be the warrior Messiah battling against the nations of the world,
וְהוּא הַנִּבְחָר מִזַּרְעָא דְּרָחֵל בְּתַכְלִית הַפְּרִישׁוּת מִתַּאֲווֹת,
being the chosen one from the seed of Rachel in ultimate detachment from bodily appetites,
וְכָל כַּעֲסוֹ רַק לִמְחוֹת שׁוֹרֶשׁ הָרַע וְזֶרַע עֲמָלֵק מִן הָעוֹלָם
and all his wrath directed solely to blot out the root of evil and the seed of Amalek from the world—
גַּם הוּא יֵהָרֵג (סֻכָּה נב.);
he too will be slain (Sukkah 52a);
הַיְינוּ דְּכֹחַ זֶה אֵינוֹ נִצְחִי,
meaning that this combative trait is not eternal,
עַד שֶׁיָּבוֹא מָשִׁיחַ בֶּן דָּוִד לַעֲשׂוֹת שָׁלוֹם בָּעוֹלָם;
until Mashiach ben David comes to establish peace in the world;
וְהוּא יְחַיֵּיהוּ לְמָשִׁיחַ בֶּן יוֹסֵף
and he will resurrect Mashiach ben Yosef
עַל יְדֵי מִדַּת הַשָּׁלוֹם הַמְחַבֵּר הַכֹּל,
through the attribute of Peace which unites everything,
דְּהַכֹּל אֶחָד וְכָל יִשְׂרָאֵל בֶּאֱמֶת בְּשָׁרְשָׁם כֻּלָּם דְּבוּקִים יַחַד.
for all is one and all Israel in ultimate truth are bound together in their root.
וְחוֹדֶשׁ אֲדָר הַמּוּכָן לִמְחִיַּת עֲמָלֵק
And the month of Adar, which is prepared for the obliteration of Amalek
וּשְׁפִיכַת הַזַּעַם דְּיוֹסֵף דְּזַרְעָא דְּרָחֵל עַל רֹאשׁ עֲמָלֵק,
and the pouring out of the wrath of Joseph from the seed of Rachel upon the head of Amalek,
הוּא נֶגֶד נַפְתָּלִי, שֶׁהוּא מִבִּלְהָה שִׁפְחַת רָחֵל;
corresponds to Naphtali, who was born of Bilhah, Rachel's maidservant;
וְהוּא הַבָּא לְחַבְּרָהּ עִם לֵאָה,
and he comes to join Rachel with Leah,
לְבָרֵר דְּבֶאֱמֶת גַּם בּוֹ אֵין שׁוּם כֹּחַ שֶׁל כַּעַס כְּלָל,
to clarify that in truth within him too there is no destructive anger at all,
וְכָל כַּעַס הוּא נֶגֶד עֲמָלֵק לְבַד.
and all zeal is directed exclusively against Amalek.
וְלִהְיוֹת עַל יְדֵי תֹּקֶף הַכַּעַס, שֶׁהוּא הַיְצִיאָה מִמַּחֲנֵה יִשְׂרָאֵל,
And since through extreme anger, which is banished outside the camp of Israel,
יוּכַל לְהִדַּמּוֹת לַגּוֹיִם חַס וְשָׁלוֹם,
one might appear to resemble the gentiles, Heaven forbid,
עַל כֵּן מִצַּד זֶה דַּיְיקָא הוּא תֹּקֶף הַמִּלְחָמָה נֶגְדָּם וְהַנִּצּוּחַ לָהֶם.
therefore specifically from this dimension springs the supreme force of war against them and their definitive defeat.
וְ"דָן יָדִין וְגוֹמֵר" (בְּרֵאשִׁית מט, טז) – עַל יְדֵי שִׁמְשׁוֹן,
And "Dan shall judge his people, etc." (Genesis 49:16)—through Samson,
שֶׁלְּמַרְאִית עַיִן טָעֲנוּ נֶגְדּוֹ: "הַאֵין בִּבְנוֹת אַחֶיךָ [וּבְכָל עַמִּי אִשָּׁה]" וְגוֹמֵר (שׁוֹפְטִים יד, ג),
concerning whom outward observers challenged: "Is there never a woman among the daughters of your brethren, etc.",
שֶׁרָצָה לִידָּבֵק חַס וְשָׁלוֹם בָּהֶם;
assuming he sought to cleave unto Philistine women, Heaven forbid;
אֲבָל בֶּאֱמֶת הַכָּתוּב הֵעִיד עָלָיו: "כִּי מֵה' הִיא, כִּי תֹאֲנָה הוּא מְבַקֵּשׁ מִפְּלִשְׁתִּים" (שָׁם, ד),
yet in truth Scripture testified of him: "for it was of Hashem, that he sought an occasion against the Philistines",
אַדְּרַבָּה, כְּדֵי לְאַבְּדָם עַל יְדֵי זֶה, לֹא לִידָּבֵק בָּהֶם כְּלָל.
on the contrary, specifically to destroy them through this encounter, not to cleave to them at all.
וְזֶהוּ הָרְבוּתָא: "כְּאַחַד שִׁבְטֵי [יִשְׂרָאֵל]"
And this is the marvel of the blessing: "as one of the tribes of Israel"—
אַף דְּהוּא הַיָּרוּד,
even though Dan was the lowliest tribe,
דּוֹמֶה לִמְיוּחָד שֶׁבַּשְּׁבָטִים, שֶׁהוּא יְהוּדָה
he is likened to the most distinguished of the tribes, which is Judah,
הַמְבָרֵר מִדַּת הַתַּאֲוָה לְשֵׁם שָׁמַיִם,
who clarified the attribute of desire for the sake of Heaven,
וְהוּא בְּתַאֲוָה שֶׁל אֱמֶת, דְּ"מִמֶּנִּי יָצְאוּ כְּבוּשִׁים" (סוֹטָה י:).
being engaged in authentic desire from which issued royal destinies.
וְאֵצֶל שִׁמְשׁוֹן הָיָה הַבֵּירוּר עַל תַּאֲוָה שֶׁל כְּזָר – לְהִתְאַוּוֹת לְגוֹיָה,
And with Samson the clarification centered upon foreign desire—lusting after a gentile woman,
דְּמִזֶּה אִי אֶפְשָׁר לִהְיוֹת בּוֹ קְדוּשָּׁה וּלְשֵׁם שָׁמַיִם כְּלָל;
wherein holiness and pure intention for Heaven seem impossible;
וְעִם כָּל זֶה, הָיָה גַּם זֶה מֵאֵת ה'.
and notwithstanding this, even that was from Hashem.
וְהַיְינוּ שֶׁבֶּאֱמֶת לֹא הָיָה כָּאן תַּאֲוָה כְּלָל,
Meaning that in internal truth there was no base lust here at all,
רַק כַּעַס שֶׁהוּא הֵיפֶךְ הַתַּאֲוָה;
but rather holy anger, which is the antithesis of lust;
וְזֶהוּ "יָדִין" – בְּמִדַּת הַדִּין, וּשְׁפִיכַת הַזַּעַם עַל פְּלִשְׁתִּים עַל יְדֵי זֶה.
and this is "he shall judge"—operating through Judgment and the outpouring of wrath upon the Philistines through this means.
וְנִמְצָא תַּאֲוָה זוֹ גַּם כֵּן שְׂחוֹק,
Thus this apparent lust was likewise sheer comedic illusion,
וְעַל דֶּרֶךְ הַשְּׂחוֹק שֶׁל אֲדָר,
in the manner of the festive laughter of Adar,
שֶׁהוּא הִתְרָאוּת גַּוֶון שֶׁל דִּמְיוֹן הֵיפֶךְ הָאֱמֶת.
which is the outward display of a semblance of illusion facing opposite the Truth.
וְזֶהוּ הַבֵּירוּר עַל כָּל חֲטָאֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל שֶׁאִי אֶפְשָׁר לְהַכְנִיסָם לִקְדוּשָּׁה:
And this is the ultimate clarification of all sins of Israel that seemingly cannot be elevated into holiness:
יְבוֹרַר שֶׁלֹּא הָיָה חֵטְא כְּלָל,
it will be demonstrated that there was no sin at all,
מִצַּד שֶׁלֹּא הָיָה הַמְכֻוָּון הָאֲמִיתִּי בּוֹ כְּמוֹ שֶׁהָיָה נִרְאֶה לְעֵין כֹּל.
because the true inner motive within it was not as it appeared to outward eyes.
וּגְאוּלָּה דְּמִצְרַיִם הָיָה עַל יְדֵי שֶׁהָיוּ גְּדוּרִים בַּעֲרָיוֹת,
And the redemption from Egypt occurred through their being fenced in modesty against immorality,
דְּלֹא נִתְעָרְבוּ בַּגּוֹיִם;
in that they did not assimilate with the gentiles;
"אַחַת הָיְתָה וּפִרְסְמָהּ הַכָּתוּב" (וַיִּקְרָא רַבָּה פָּרָשָׁה לב, ה; בַּמִּדְבָּר רַבָּה פָּרָשָׁה כ, כד) – לְמַטֵּה דָן.
"one woman stumbled and Scripture publicized her"—from the tribe of Dan.
וְאֶסְתֵּר, שֶׁהוּא סוֹף כָּל הַנִּסִּים,
And with Esther, who marks the end of all biblical miracles,
הָיָה נִרְאֶה עֵירוּב בַּגּוֹיִם;
there appeared an outward intermingling with gentiles;
וְזֶהוּ הַסּוֹף שֶׁמַּגִּיעַ מַמָּשׁ לְגֶדֶר הַהֵיפֶךְ מִמִּתְּחִלָּה.
and this is the culmination that reaches literally the exact opposite boundary from the beginning.
וְגַם בּוֹ הָיָה נִיכָּר קְדוּשַׁת יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּיֶתֶר שְׂאֵת,
And within her too was recognized the sanctity of Israel with greater intensity,
דִּ"לָבְשָׁתָהּ רוּחַ הַקֹּדֶשׁ" (מְגִילָּה יד:)
in that "the Holy Spirit clothed her" (Megillah 14b)
בְּעֵת שֶׁהָלְכָה לְעִנְיָן שֶׁהוּא בְּתַכְלִית הַגְּנוּת.
at the very moment she proceeded toward that which appeared as the ultimate degradation.
וְזֶהוּ גְּאוּלָּה אַחֲרוֹנָה שֶׁנִּיתְּנָה לִכְתֹּב בְּגָלוּי לָעַמִּים
And this was the final redemption permitted to be transcribed openly for the nations—
תַּכְלִית הַהֶבְדֵּל שֶׁבֵּינָם לְיִשְׂרָאֵל;
displaying the ultimate distinction between them and Israel;
דְּגַם בִּהְיוֹת "אַכַּתֵּי עַבְדֵי אֲחַשְׁוֵרוֹשׁ אֲנַן" (מְגִילָּה יד.),
for even while "we are still servants of Ahasuerus",
וְאֵין שָׁם נִסִּים גְּלוּיִם בְּיָד רָמָה,
and there are no overt miracles performed with a high hand,
רַק בְּהִתְלַבְּשׁוּת בְּדֶרֶךְ הַטֶּבַע,
operating merely through enclothement within the natural order,
שֶׁהַמֶּלֶךְ נֶעְתַּר לְאַהֲבַת אִשְׁתּוֹ,
wherein the king acquiesced to the love of his wife,
מִכָּל מָקוֹם "רַבִּים מֵעַמֵּי הָאָרֶץ מִתְיַהֲדִים וְגוֹמֵר" (אֶסְתֵּר ח, יז);
nonetheless "many of the peoples of the land became Jews, etc.";
שֶׁהָיָה נִיכָּר לְעֵין כֹּל
for it was manifest before the eyes of all
אֵיךְ כָּל הַהַנְהָגָה – מֵהֲרִיגַת וַשְׁתִּי וּלְקִיחַת אֶסְתֵּר
how the entire unfolding—from the execution of Vashti to the taking of Esther—
הַכֹּל הָיָה מֵאֵת הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ לְטוֹבַת יִשְׂרָאֵל,
was entirely orchestrated from Hashem, blessed be He, for the good of Israel,
וְ"גַם בְּעַבְדוּתֵנוּ לֹא עֲזָבָנוּ [אֱלֹהֵינוּ]" (עֶזְרָא ט, ט).
and "even in our servitude our God has not forsaken us" (Ezra 9:9).
וְכֵן בְּעִנְיַן הַקְּדוּשָּׁה הָרוּחָנִית נֶאֱמַר: "הַשֹּׁכֵן אִתָּם בְּתוֹךְ טֻמְאֹתָם" (וַיִּקְרָא טז, טז),
And so regarding spiritual sanctity it is stated: "Who dwells with them in the midst of their uncleanness" (Leviticus 16:16),
וּ"מֵעוֹלָם לֹא זָזָה שְׁכִינָה מִכֹּתֶל מַעֲרָבִי" (שְׁמוֹת רַבָּה פָּרָשָׁה ב, ב).
and "never did the Shechinah depart from the Western Wall" (Shemot Rabbah 2:2).
וְיָדוּעַ דְּמַעֲרָב נִקְרָא "אֲחוֹר",
And it is known that the west is termed 'the back' (Achor),
וְהוּא כְּטַעַם: "וְרָאִיתָ אֶת אֲחֹרָי [וּפָנַי לֹא יֵרָאוּ]" (שְׁמוֹת לג, כג);
in the sense of: "and you shall see My back, but My face shall not be seen" (Exodus 33:23);
דִּרְאִיַּת פָּנִים – זֶה הָיָה בְּבֵית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ וּבְעֵת תֹּקֶף הַהִתְגַּלּוּת;
for the vision of the Face occurred in the Holy Temple during the height of revelation;
אֲבָל מִכֹּתֶל מַעֲרָבִי, דְּהַיְינוּ בְּהֶעְלֵם – זֶה לֹא זָז מֵעוֹלָם.
whereas from the Western Wall, representing concealment, He never departed.
דְּאַף בְּכָל הַהַעֲלָמוֹת: "גַּם כִּי אֵלֵךְ בְּגֵיא צַלְמָוֶת" (תְּהִלִּים כג, ד)
For even amid all concealments: "Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death"—
רָצָה לוֹמַר בְּכָל מִינֵי שִׁיקּוּעַ שֶׁל רַע הַמַּר מִמָּוֶת
meaning amid every depth of evil bitterer than death—
"לֹא אִירָא רָע, כִּי אַתָּה עִמָּדִי",
still "I will fear no evil, for You are with me",
דְּגַם שָׁם "יְמִינְךָ תַנְחֵנִי" (שָׁם קלט, י).
for even there "Your right hand shall lead me" (Psalms 139:10).
וּכְסְבוּרִים אָנוּ שֶׁזֶּה גְּרִיעוּת וְחִסָּרוֹן,
And we might presume this state to be an inferiority and lack,
וּבֶאֱמֶת זֶה תֹּקֶף שְׁלֵימוּת;
yet in truth this is the supreme height of perfection;
כִּי זֶהוּ תַּכְלִית הַבֵּירוּר:
for this is the ultimate clarification:
שֶׁאֲפִילּוּ יִשְׁתַּקַּע לְהֵיכָן שֶׁיִּשְׁתַּקַּע,
that wherever a Jew may sink,
עִם כָּל זֶה לִבּוֹ קָשׁוּר בְּקֶשֶׁר אַמִּיץ בַּהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ,
nonetheless his heart remains bound in a mighty knot unto Hashem, blessed be He,
שֶׁאִי אֶפְשָׁר לְהִנָּתֵק כְּלָל.
which cannot be severed whatsoever.
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁלֹּא יִתְגַּלֶּה אַהֲבַת הַבֵּן לָאָב
And just as a son's love for his father is not fully tested
כַּאֲשֶׁר הוּא עִמּוֹ פָּנִים בְּפָנִים,
when he stands with him face-to-face,
וְהָאָב מֵיטִיב לוֹ בְּכָל מִינֵי טוֹבוֹת וַאֲהָבוֹת,
and the father showers him with all manner of bounties and affections,
דְּאֵין חִידּוּשׁ אִם הַבֵּן אוֹהֵב לָאָב גַּם כֵּן;
where it is no novelty if the son loves the father in return;
אֲבָל כַּאֲשֶׁר הַבֵּן מְרוּחָק מֵאָבִיו בְּתַכְלִית
however, when the son is distanced from his father to the furthest extreme,
שֶׁאֵין נֶהֱנֶה מִמֶּנּוּ כְּלָל,
deriving no visible benefit from him at all,
וְעִם כָּל זֶה לִבּוֹ נוֹהֶה אַחֲרָיו
and despite this his heart yearns passionately after him—
זֶה מֵעִיד עַל אַהֲבָתוֹ.
this bears undeniable witness to his essential love.
וְעַל כֵּן לְעוֹלָם בֵּירוּר יִשְׂרָאֵל הָיָה עַל יְדֵי גָּלוּיוֹת,
Therefore the spiritual refinement of Israel has always unfolded through exiles,
וְכָל גָּלוּת וַדַּאי גּוֹרֵם שִׁיקּוּעַ בָּרַע;
and every exile certainly causes outward immersion in worldly dross;
וְעַד שֶׁבְּמִצְרַיִם הִגִּיעוּ לְמַה שֶּׁאָמְרוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה (וַיִּקְרָא רַבָּה פָּרָשָׁה כג, ב)
until in Egypt they reached that state concerning which our Sages expounded (Vayikra Rabbah 23:2)
עַל פָּסוּק "גּוֹי מִקֶּרֶב גּוֹי" (דְּבָרִים ד, לד):
on the verse "a nation from the midst of another nation":
הַלָּלוּ עוֹבְדֵי עֲבוֹדָה זָרָה וְהַלָּלוּ עוֹבְדֵי עֲבוֹדָה זָרָה;
these were idolaters and those were idolaters;
וְזֶה הָיָה הֲכָנָה לְמַתַּן תּוֹרָה.
and this very descent was the preparation for the Giving of the Torah.
הַיְינוּ כִּי נִתְבָּרְרוּ כָּל כָּךְ,
Meaning that they were refined to such depth,
שֶׁאֲפִילּוּ בְּתַכְלִית שִׁיקּוּעַ עָצוּם,
that even in the abyss of immense immersion,
עִם כָּל זֶה הֵם בֶּאֱמֶת דָּבוּק לְגַמְרֵי בַּהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ;
nonetheless they remained in ultimate truth completely cleaving unto Hashem, blessed be He;
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה (שִׁיר הַשִּׁירִים רַבָּה א, ו)
and as our Sages expounded (Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:6)
עַל פָּסוּק "שֶׁשְּׁזָפַתְנִי הַשָּׁמֶשׁ":
on the verse "because the sun has tanned me":
דִּבִרְחִיצָה מוּעֶטֶת מִתְנַקִּים,
that with a slight washing they are scoured clean,
כִּי אֵין הַחִסָּרוֹן בְּעֶצֶם כְּלָל.
for the blemish does not touch their essence whatsoever.
וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה זָכוּ לְתַכְלִית הַהִתְגַּלּוּת הַיּוֹתֵר עָצוּם שֶׁהָיָה בָּעוֹלָם הַזֶּה:
And through this they merited the most transcendent revelation that ever occurred in this world:
לְהִבָּחֵר לְעַם מְיוּחָד.
to be chosen as a consecrated nation.
וּמִשֶּׁנִּבְחֲרוּ יִשְׂרָאֵל, אִי אֶפְשָׁר לָהֶם עוֹד לְהִשְׁתַּנּוֹת;
And once Israel was chosen, it became impossible for them ever to be transformed into anything else;
וַאֲפִילּוּ הִגְדִּיל עֲווֹנוֹת עַד לְמַעְלָה
and even if one multiplies transgressions to the skies—
"אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁחָטָא, יִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא" (סַנְהֶדְרִין מד:),
"even though he sinned, he remains Israel" (Sanhedrin 44a),
וְאִי אֶפְשָׁר לַעֲקוֹר מִמֶּנּוּ שֵׁם יִשְׂרָאֵל כְּלָל בְּשׁוּם אֹפֶן.
and it is impossible to uproot from him the name of Israel under any circumstance.
וְכָל טַעֲנַת הָאֻמּוֹת הוּא רַק: "אָנוּ יִשְׂרָאֵל",
And the whole counter-claim of the nations is merely: "We are Israel",
שֶׁגַּם הֵם חֲשׁוּבִים כִּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אוֹ עוֹד יוֹתֵר;
alleging that they too are esteemed like the children of Israel or even more;
כִּי מֵאַחַר שֶׁיִּשְׂרָאֵל קְדוֹשִׁים אַף שֶׁעוֹשִׂים כַּיּוֹצֵא בָּזֶה,
for since Israel remains holy even when stumbling in such matters,
לְפִי דַּעְתָּם יַחְשְׁבוּ שֶׁגַּם הוּא כֵּן.
they assume in their superficial logic that they must be the same.
וְעַל זֶה הוּא הַבֵּירוּר גְּאוּלָּה דִּימֵי אֲחַשְׁוֵרוֹשׁ:
And concerning this unfolded the clarification of the redemption in the days of Ahasuerus:
לְבָרֵר דְּהֵם לֹא עָשׂוּ אֶלָּא לִפְנִים (מְגִילָּה יב.),
to demonstrate that Israel sinned only outwardly (lifnim),
וְלֹא עִינָּה מִלִּבּוֹ;
never consenting in their true heart;
מַה שֶּׁאֵין כֵּן אֻמּוֹת הָעוֹלָם, מַה שֶּׁעוֹשִׂין הוּא בֶּאֱמֶת.
whereas the nations of the world, whatever wickedness they do is done in full internal truth.
וְזֶהוּ בְּשַׁבָּת (פח.):
And this reflects what is taught in Shabbat (88a):
דִּבְהַר סִינַי "כָּפָה עֲלֵיהֶם הַר כְּגִיגִית",
that at Mount Sinai "He suspended the mountain over them like a vat",
וְהָדַר קִבְּלוּהָ בִּימֵי אֲחַשְׁוֵרוֹשׁ בְּרָצוֹן;
and subsequently they reaffirmed and accepted it in the days of Ahasuerus willingly;
הַיְינוּ דְּמַה שֶּׁאִי אֶפְשָׁר לַעֲקוֹר מִמֶּנּוּ שֵׁם יִשְׂרָאֵל
meaning that the immutable permanence of the identity of Israel
נִרְאֶה כִּמְסַלֵּק הַבְּחִירָה מִמֶּנּוּ,
appears superficially as though it stripped free choice away from him,
וְהַיְינוּ כְּפִיַּת הָהָר – דִּבְעַל כָּרְחוֹ יִהְיֶה יִשְׂרָאֵל;
which corresponds to the coercion of the mountain—that perforce he must remain Israel;
וּבִימֵי אֲחַשְׁוֵרוֹשׁ קִבְּלוּהָ
yet in the days of Ahasuerus they accepted it—
הַיְינוּ שֶׁנִּתְבָּרֵר
meaning it was clarified
שֶׁזֶּה שֶׁאֵינוֹ נֶעֱקָר מִשּׁוֹרֶשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֵין זֶה דֶּרֶךְ כְּפִיָּה וְשֶׁלֹּא בִּבְחִירָה,
that his unbreakable bond to the root of Israel is not an external coercion lacking volition,
רַק דְּבֶאֱמֶת הוּא בְּשָׁרְשׁוֹ בּוֹחֵר מֵרְצוֹנוֹ בּוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ.
but that in ultimate truth he chooses in his innermost root to cling willingly unto Him, blessed be He.
וּכְמַה שֶּׁכָּתַב הָרַמְבַּ״ם (הִלְכוֹת גֵּרוּשִׁין פֶּרֶק ב, כ)
And as Maimonides wrote (Hilchot Geirushin 2:20)
בְּטַעַם "כּוֹפִין אוֹתוֹ עַד שֶׁיֹּאמַר רוֹצֶה אָנִי":
on the rationale of "they compel him until he says: I am willing":
דַּאֲפִילּוּ הוּא רָשָׁע וְאֵינוֹ רוֹצֶה לְקַבֵּל דִּבְרֵי חֲכָמִים,
that even if he is wicked and refuses to obey the words of the Sages,
אֲמִיתַּת רְצוֹנוֹ אֵינוֹ כֵן.
the essential truth of his inner soul desires to obey.
וְזֶה הָיָה הַבֵּירוּר אָז: דְּהַכֹּל לִפְנִים,
And this was the revelation then: that their sin was purely superficial,
וּכְעֵין דֶּרֶךְ שְׂחוֹק;
and partook of the nature of comedic illusion;
וְזֶה תֹּקֶף גָּדוֹל יוֹתֵר וּכְמַה שֶּׁנִּתְבָּאֵר.
and this constitutes a far greater spiritual strength, as explained.
וְעַל זֶה אָמְרוּ (מִדְרַשׁ מִשְׁלֵי ט, ב):
And concerning this our Sages stated (Midrash Mishlei 9:2):
אֲפִילּוּ כָּל הַמּוֹעֲדִים בְּטֵלִים, יְמֵי הַפּוּרִים לֹא יִהְיוּ נִבְטָלִים;
even should all festivals be annulled, the days of Purim shall never be annulled;
כִּי בִּיטּוּל הַמּוֹעֲדוֹת
for the future eclipse of the pilgrimage festivals—
דְּ"לֹא יֵאָמֵר עוֹד חַי ה' אֲשֶׁר הֶעֱלָה [אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם]" וְגוֹמֵר (יִרְמְיָה טז, יד),
in that "it shall no more be said: As Hashem lives, that brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt, etc.",
דְּהַיְינוּ הַיְצִיאָה מֵאֵיזֶה שִׁיקּוּעַ פְּרָטִי דְּרַע,
marks liberation from some specific historical descent into evil;
כִּי כְּבָר יָצְאוּ לְגַמְרֵי מִכָּל מִינֵי רַע
for then they will have departed entirely from every variety of evil,
עַד שֶׁיְּבוֹעַר הָרַע מִן הָעוֹלָם,
until evil is eradicated from the world,
עַד שֶׁלֹּא נִיכָּר עוֹד שׁוֹעַ לִפְנֵי דָל;
so that the nobleman is no longer favored before the pauper;
וּקְדוּשַׁת כָּל מוֹעֵד
and the sanctity of each biblical festival
הוּא מַה שֶּׁנִּקְבַּע בְּלִבְבוֹת כָּל הַדּוֹרוֹת מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל
is that which was permanently engraved in the hearts of all generations of Israel
אוֹתָהּ קְדוּשָּׁה שֶׁנִּתְגַּלָּה עַל יְדֵי אוֹתוֹ מוֹפֵת וְנֵס פְּרָטִי
from that holiness disclosed through that specific historical miracle
שֶׁעָלָיו נִקְבַּע הַיּוֹם טוֹב;
upon which the festival was instituted;
וְכַאֲשֶׁר יִתְגַּלֶּה קְדוּשָּׁה יוֹתֵר,
and when a greater, all-encompassing holiness is revealed in the messianic era,
אָז נִתְבַּטֵּל זוֹ,
then that lesser light is subsumed,
עַל דֶּרֶךְ: "שְׁרָגָא בְּטִיהֲרָא [מַאי מְהַנְיָא]" (חֻלִּין ס:).
along the lines of: "What does a small lamp profit at high noon?" (Chullin 60b).
אֲבָל עִנְיַן הַפּוּרִים,
However, the essence of Purim,
דְּאֵינוֹ יְצִיאָה מִשִּׁיקּוּעַ רַק פְּרָטִי,
does not represent liberation from merely a specific temporal vice,
רַק הַיְצִיאָה מִשּׁוֹרֶשׁ הָרַע כְּלָלִי דְּ"רֵאשִׁית גּוֹיִם עֲמָלֵק",
but deliverance from the universal root of evil, 'Amalek, the first of the nations',
שֶׁהוּא הַמַּכְחִישׁ הַשּׁוֹרֶשׁ.
who denies the transcendent Root.
וּפוּרִים מְבָרֵר שׁוֹרֶשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל:
And Purim clarifies the indestructible root of Israel:
שֶׁאֲפִילּוּ הֵם בְּכָל רַע – אֵינוֹ אֱמֶת;
that even while they appear trapped in evil—it is not their ultimate Truth;
זֶה לֹא יִתְבַּטֵּל,
this revelation shall never be annulled,
דְּזֶה עִנְיָן בִּפְנֵי עַצְמוֹ שֶׁאֵין לוֹ שַׁיָּיכוּת לְכָל מוֹעֲדִים
for this is a unique category holding no parallel with other festivals
וּלְכָל מִינֵי גְּאוּלוֹת הָעֲתִידוֹת.
nor with all future redemptions.
שֶׁכָּל גְּאוּלָּה הוּא הַיְצִיאָה מֵרַע לְטוֹב;
For every other redemption is an exodus from evil into good;
אֲבָל פּוּרִים אֵינוֹ יְצִיאָה לְטוֹב,
whereas Purim is not merely an exodus into good,
רַק דְּגַם בִּהְיוֹתוֹ רַע – אֵינוֹ רַע כְּלָל.
but the revelation that even while appearing evil—the Jew is not evil at all.
וּקְדוּשָּׁה זוֹ שֶׁיֶּשְׁנָהּ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל
And this intrinsic holiness residing in Israel
אֵינָהּ מִתְבַּטֶּלֶת עַל יְדֵי קְדוּשָּׁה אַחֶרֶת הַגְּדוֹלָה מִמֶּנָּה,
is never eclipsed by any other holiness however great,
שֶׁהֵם הַכֹּל מִצַּד הַמַּעֲלָה;
for those are evaluated from the perspective of overt spiritual attainment;
מַה שֶּׁאֵין כֵּן מַעֲלַת יְמֵי הַפּוּרִים הוּא מִצַּד הַחִסָּרוֹן,
whereas the preeminence of the days of Purim emerges specifically out of deficiency,
וּכְפִי גּוֹדֶל הַחִסָּרוֹן – הוּא גּוֹדֶל הַמַּעֲלָה.
and commensurate with the depth of the deficiency—is the supreme greatness of the virtue.
וְנַפְתָּלִי הוּא אַחֲרוֹן הַדְּגָלִים כְּפִי סֵדֶר הַדְּגָלִים;
And Naphtali is the final tribe of the banners according to their camp formation;
שֶׁדָּן "מְאַסֵּף לְכָל הַמַּחֲנֹת" (בַּמִּדְבָּר י, כה) הוּא רֹאשׁ הַדֶּגֶל,
wherein Dan, 'the rear guard of all the camps', leads the northern banner,
וְנִקְרָא עַל שְׁמוֹ "מַחֲנֵה דָן",
and it is named after him 'the Camp of Dan',
אַף דְּהוּא הַיָּרוּד שֶׁבַּשְּׁבָטִים (שְׁמוֹת רַבָּה פָּרָשָׁה מ, ד).
even though he is the lowliest among the tribes (Shemot Rabbah 40:4).
מִכָּל מָקוֹם, עִנְיַן מְאַסֵּף הַמַּחֲנוֹת הוּא עַל יְדֵי זֶה שֶׁהוּא הַיָּרוּד
Nevertheless, the function of gathering all camps belongs to him because he is the lowest,
וּמְאַסֵּף כָּל הַמַּדְרֵגוֹת הַיּוֹתֵר תַּחְתּוֹנוֹת מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל,
gathering up all the lowliest spiritual echelons of Israel,
וְזֶהוּ עִיקַּר דִּגְלוֹ.
and this is the primary mission of his banner.
וְשֵׁבֶט דָּן הוּא תַּכְלִית הַיָּרוּד;
And the tribe of Dan occupies the furthest boundary of the lowly;
אֲבָל אָשֵׁר וְנַפְתָּלִי הֵם הַמְחַבְּרִים הַיָּרוּד עִם הַמְעֻלֶּה,
yet Asher and Naphtali are those who connect the lowly with the exalted,
וְנַפְתָּלִי הוּא תַּכְלִית וְעִיקַּר הַמְחַבֵּר.
and Naphtali is the ultimate and principal unifier.
כְּמוֹ: "עֹשֶׁר כְּבוֹד מַלְכוּתוֹ" (אֶסְתֵּר א, ד)
Like the verse: "the riches of his glorious kingdom"—
נִרְאֶה דְּהָיָה לוֹ עֹשֶׁר מֻפְלָג מַה שֶּׁלֹּא הָיָה כֵן לְשׁוּם מֶלֶךְ;
it is evident that Ahasuerus possessed extraordinary wealth unmatched by any monarch;
וְנִרְאֶה דְּאָז בְּאוֹתוֹ דּוֹר הָיָה מוּשְׁפָּע שֶׁפַע עֹשֶׁר רַב מִן הַשָּׁמַיִם,
and it appears that then in that generation a vast influx of wealth was channeled from Heaven,
כִּי אוֹתוֹ דּוֹר דְּאַנְשֵׁי כְּנֶסֶת הַגְּדוֹלָה הוּא הַתְחָלַת תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה;
because that generation of the Men of the Great Assembly inaugurated the era of the Oral Torah;
וְיָדוּעַ תּוֹרָה שֶׁבִּכְתָב וְתוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה הֵם בְּחִינַת דְּכַר וְנוּקְבָא,
and it is known that the Written Torah and Oral Torah are masculine and feminine,
כִּי תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה מְקַבֵּל מִתּוֹרָה שֶׁבִּכְתָב.
for the Oral Torah receives from the Written Torah.
וְאָמְרוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה בְּבָבָא מְצִיעָא (נט.):
And our Sages of blessed memory said in Bava Metzia (59a):
"אוֹקִירוּ לִנְשַׁיְיכוּ כִּי הֵיכִי דְּתִתְעַתְּרוּ",
"Honor your wives so that you may become wealthy",
כִּי הִיא בְּחִינַת הַגְּבוּרוֹת קְדוֹשׁוֹת
because the feminine embodies the holy Gevurot (Nukva)
שֶׁמִּשָּׁם הָעֲשִׁירוּת וְ"זָהָב יֵאָתֶה" (אִיּוֹב לז, כב);
whence emerges wealth: "out of the north comes golden splendor";
וְכֵן תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה הוּא הוֹסָפַת גְּזֵירוֹת וּגְדָרִים.
and so the Oral Torah consists of instituting fences, decrees, and boundaries (Gevurot).
וְלִהְיוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּגָּלוּת, הָיוּ הֵם בְּתַכְלִית הָעֹנִי,
And Israel being in exile were then in the depth of poverty,
כִּמְפוֹרָשׁ בַּקְּרָא בְּעוֹלֵי גוֹלָה;
as explicit in Scripture regarding the returnees from Babylon;
וְעַיֵּין בְּרִבִּית שֶׁל שַׁמַּאי [רַשִׁבַּ"ם בָּבָא בַּתְרָא פו: דִּבּוּר הַמַּתְחִיל "פְּרוּטָה"]
and see in Rashbam on Bava Batra 86b, s.v. "Perutah"
לְעִנְיַן שִׁיעוּר פְּרוּטָה דְּחָשֵׁיב כֶּסֶף לְכָל דָּבָר אַף דְּהוּא דָּבָר מוּעָט,
regarding the legal definition of a perutah being deemed substantial money for all halakhic matters despite its tiny value,
כִּי דּוֹר אַנְשֵׁי כְּנֶסֶת הַגְּדוֹלָה הָיוּ עֲנִיִּים בְּיוֹתֵר, עַיֵּין שָׁם.
because the generation of the Men of the Great Assembly were impoverished in the extreme, see there.
וְכָל הַשֶּׁפַע דְּעוֹלָם הַזֶּה הָיָה הוֹלֵךְ לְאֻמּוֹת הָעוֹלָם,
And all the material wealth of this world was diverted to the nations,
וְקִבֵּל הַכֹּל מֶלֶךְ אֻמּוֹת הָעוֹלָם שֶׁהוּא הָרֹאשׁ שֶׁיִּשְׂרָאֵל הָיוּ מְשֻׁעְבָּדִים לוֹ;
and the king of the nations, who ruled as the imperial head over Israel, received it all;
וְגַם הָמָן לִהְיוֹתוֹ צוֹרֵר הַיְּהוּדִים
and likewise Haman, being the adversary of the Jews—
כָּל הַמֵּצַר לְיִשְׂרָאֵל נַעֲשֶׂה רֹאשׁ (גִּיטִּין נו:)
for 'whoever oppresses Israel is made a chief' (Gittin 56b)
לְפִי שָׁעָה בְּעָלְמָא דְּשִׁקְרָא;
temporarily in this world of falsehood;
וְכַאֲשֶׁר גִּדְּלוֹ הַמֶּלֶךְ, קָלַט הוּא כָּל שֶׁפַע עֹשֶׁר הָרָאוּי לְיִשְׂרָאֵל.
and when the king promoted him, he absorbed all the influx of riches destined for Israel.
וְגַם בְּהָמָן נֶאֱמַר: "וַיְסַפֵּר [לָהֶם הָמָן] אֶת כְּבוֹד עָשְׁרוֹ וְרֹב בָּנָיו" (אֶסְתֵּר ה, יא);
And regarding Haman too it is written: "And Haman recounted unto them the glory of his riches, and the multitude of his children";
כַּיָּדוּעַ דְּאֻמּוֹת הָעוֹלָם מוֹנִין לַחַמָּה וְיִשְׂרָאֵל לַלְּבָנָה (סֻכָּה כט.),
for it is known that the nations reckon their calendar by the sun and Israel by the moon (Sukkah 29a),
וְכֵן נִמְשְׁלוּ לָהֶם, כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה (שִׁיר הַשִּׁירִים רַבָּה ו, י):
and so are they allegorized, as our Sages expounded (Shir HaShirim Rabbah 6:10):
דִּלְבָנָה מוֹשֶׁלֶת בַּיּוֹם וּבַלַּיְלָה וְכֵן יִשְׂרָאֵל.
that the moon exercises presence by day and by night, and so Israel.
וְאָמְרוּ בְּסוֹף שַׁבָּת (קנו.):
And they stated at the end of Shabbat (156a):
מַאן דִּבְחַמָּה – אָכֵיל וְשָׁתֵי מִדִּילֵיהּ וְרָזוֹהִי גַּלְיָין;
he who is born under the sun eats and drinks of his own and his secrets are exposed;

And likewise corresponding to them in the Torah: the fifty Gates of Understanding,
דְּמֵ"ט נִתְגַּלּוּ לְמֹשֶׁה רַבֵּינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם (רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה כא:),
of which forty-nine were revealed to Moses our teacher, peace be upon him (Rosh Hashanah 21b),
"וַתְּחַסְּרֵהוּ מְּעַט מֵאֱלֹהִים" (תְּהִלִּים ח, ו) – הוּא שַׁעַר הַנ',
and "You made him a little less than the angels" refers to the fiftieth gate,
שֶׁהוּא הַמְזוּקָּק לְגַמְרֵי, זֶה אִי אֶפְשָׁר לְהִתְגַּלּוֹת בָּעוֹלָם הַזֶּה.
which is completely refined and purified, and this gate cannot be openly revealed in this world.
וְיָדוּעַ שִׁשִּׁים רִבּוֹא אוֹתִיּוֹת בַּתּוֹרָה נֶגֶד שִׁשִּׁים רִבּוֹא נַפְשׁוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל,
And it is known that there are sixty myriad letters in the Torah corresponding to the sixty myriad souls of Israel,
וְהֵם בֶּאֱמֶת נ' פַּעַם שִׁשִּׁים רִבּוֹא נֶגֶד נ' שַׁעֲרֵי בִינָה,
and in truth they total fifty times sixty myriad corresponding to the fifty Gates of Understanding,
כִּי כָּל אֶחָד כָּלוּל מִנ';
for each root-soul is compounded of fifty;
וְזֶהוּ "אֶחָד מֵחֲמִשִּׁים"
and this is the meaning of 'one out of fifty'—
הַיְינוּ שֶׁכָּל אֶחָד הָיָה אָחוּז וְכוֹלֵל מֵהַחֲמִשִּׁים.
namely that each individual was attached to and comprised of the fifty.
וּגְאוּלַּת מִצְרַיִם שֶׁהָיָה בְּיָד רָמָה,
And the Exodus from Egypt, which took place with a high hand,
וּבֶאֱמֶת בָּעוֹלָם הַזֶּה אֵין יָד רָמָה כָּל כָּךְ לְיִשְׂרָאֵל,
yet in truth in this world a high hand is not permanently manifest for Israel,
הוּצְרְכוּ לֵילֵךְ לַמִּדְבָּר
they were therefore required to journey into the wilderness
וְלִהְיוֹת פְּרוּשִׁים מֵעוֹלָם הַזֶּה לְגַמְרֵי
and be completely detached from this physical world,
וְלֶאֱכֹל לֶחֶם מִן הַשָּׁמַיִם כְּמַלְאֲכֵי הַשָּׁרֵת אוֹכְלִין (יוֹמָא עה:);
and to eat bread from Heaven like ministering angels consume (Yoma 75b);
וְעַל כֵּן זָכוּ לָזֶה רַק שִׁשִּׁים רִבּוֹא הַמְזוּקָּקִים לְגַמְרֵי.
and therefore only the sixty myriad who were completely refined merited this.
כִּי אָז הָיָה בְּפִרְסוּם דְּתוֹרָה שֶׁבִּכְתָב
For then it occurred through the public revelation of the Written Torah—
רָזוֹהִי גַּלְיָין, בְּאֵר הֵיטֵב בְּשִׁבְעִים לָשׁוֹן,
its mysteries exposed, fully clarified in seventy tongues (Deuteronomy 27:8),
שֶׁהוּא מִדַּת יוֹם;
which is the attribute of day;
מַה שֶּׁאֵין כֵּן תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה – מִדַּת לַיְלָה,
unlike the Oral Torah, which belongs to the attribute of night,
רָזוֹהִי כַּסְיָין, דְּהוּא מִסְטוֹרִין שֶׁלּוֹ
its secrets concealed, being His esoteric mysteries
שֶׁאִי אֶפְשָׁר לְגַלּוֹת לְאֻמּוֹת הָעוֹלָם כְּלָל.
which cannot be revealed to the nations of the world at all.
וְזֶהוּ קַבָּלַת הַתּוֹרָה בִּימֵי אֲחַשְׁוֵרוֹשׁ שֶׁהָיָה בְּהֶסְתֵּר,
And this was the receiving of the Torah in the days of Ahasuerus which occurred in concealment,
דְּ"אַכַּתֵּי עַבְדֵי אֲחַשְׁוֵרוֹשׁ אֲנַן" (מְגִילָּה יד.) לְמַרְאִית הָעַיִן,
for to outward appearance "we are still the servants of Ahasuerus" (Megillah 14a),
וְלֹא חֵירוּת מֵהַמַּלְכֻיּוֹת,
and there was no political freedom from foreign empires,
וְכֵן מִיֵּצֶר הָרָע,
nor overt liberation from the evil inclination,
כִּי הַכֹּל אֶחָד: שְׂאוֹר שֶׁבָּעִסָּה וְשִׁעְבּוּד מַלְכֻיּוֹת דְּהָא בְּהָא תַּלְיָא.
for both are one: the leaven in the dough and the subjugation to empires, the two being mutually dependent.
וּבְעֵת מַתַּן תּוֹרָה הָיָה חֵירוּת מִשְּׁנֵיהֶם;
And at the Giving of the Torah at Sinai there was liberation from both;
מַה שֶּׁאֵין כֵּן בִּימֵי אֲחַשְׁוֵרוֹשׁ,
whereas in the days of Ahasuerus,
אַף דְּבֶאֱמֶת הָדַר קִבְּלוּהָ אָז מֵאַהֲבָה
even though in truth they reaffirmed and accepted it then out of love
וְהוּא תֹּקֶף מַעֲלָה יְתֵירָה,
which is an even more powerful, supreme virtue,
מִכָּל מָקוֹם הוּא בְּהִתְכַּסּוּת וּבְהֶעְלֵם;
nonetheless it occurred in hiddenness and concealment;
דַּהֲרֵי בְּהִתְגַּלּוּת הָיָה עֲלֵיהֶם טַעֲנוֹת,
for in the manifest realm there were valid accusations against them,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה (מְגִילָּה יב.):
as our Sages of blessed memory noted (Megillah 12a):
דְּהֵם לֹא עָשׂוּ אֶלָּא לִפְנִים
that they acted only superficially (lifnim)—
רָצָה לוֹמַר רַק מִצַּד הַהִתְגַּלּוּת בְּמַעֲשֶׂה,
meaning only from the perspective of outward, manifest action,
אֲבָל פְּנִימִיּוּת לִבָּם הוּא לַה'.
whereas the inner core of their heart remained dedicated to Hashem.
וְזֶהוּ הַגְּאוּלָּה דְּאָז,
And this was the nature of the redemption then,
הַמְבָרֶרֶת עַל חֲטָאֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל,
which clarifies concerning the sins of Israel
גַּם בִּהְיוֹתָם חוֹטְאִים – פְּנִימִיּוּת לִבָּם לַשָּׁמַיִם,
that even while they appear to sin—their inner heart remains directed toward Heaven,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁנִּתְבָּאֵר לְמַעְלָה.
as explained above.
וּכְלַל יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּצֵירוּף הָרְשָׁעִים שֶׁנִּתְבָּרְרוּ אָז כִּי "לֹא יִדַּח מִמֶּנּוּ נִדָּח" (שְׁמוּאֵל ב יד, יד),
And the collective of Israel together with the wicked who were then clarified through the principle that "none of them shall be cast out",
הֵם נ' פַּעַם שִׁשִּׁים רִבּוֹא,
totaled fifty times sixty myriad,
שֶׁזֶּהוּ מִסְפַּר הַפָּחוֹת מִכַּמָּה פְּעָמִים;
which represents the minimal base count in multiple scenarios;
כִּי בַּבְּרָכָה נֶאֱמַר: "יֹסֵף עֲלֵיכֶם כָּכֶם אֶלֶף פְּעָמִים" (דְּבָרִים א, יא),
for in the biblical blessing it is stated: "May Hashem add unto you a thousand times as many as you are" (Deuteronomy 1:11),
שֶׁזֶּהוּ מִסְפָּר הַמּוֹרֶה רִיבּוּי בְּלֹא שִׁיעוּר,
which is a number denoting boundless, immeasurable increase,
כְּמַה שֶּׁכָּתַב הָרַמְבַּ״ן עַל פָּסוּק: "הִנֵּה נָתַתִּי אֶלֶף כֶּסֶף לְאָחִיךְ" (בְּרֵאשִׁית כ, טז),
as Ramban wrote on the verse: "Behold, I have given your brother a thousand pieces of silver",
וּכְמַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב בַּזֹּהַר (חֵלֶק א, קסא:)
and as written in the Zohar (Part I, 161b)
דְּכָל בְּרָכָה הוּא בְּמִסְפַּר אֶלֶף.
that every divine blessing is couched in the number one thousand.
וְיָדוּעַ דְּהַמִּסְפָּרִים הוֹלְכִים: אֲחָדִים, עֲשָׂרוֹת, מֵאוֹת, אֲלָפִים;
And it is known that numbers progress: units, tens, hundreds, thousands;
וְאֶלֶף הוּא רִיבּוּי הָאֶחָד
and one thousand is the multiplied completion of the single unit,
שֶׁמִּמֶּנּוּ חוֹזֵר הַמִּסְפָּר: עֲשָׂרוֹת אֲלָפִים, מֵאוֹת אֲלָפִים.
from which the numerical sequence restarts: tens of thousands, hundreds of thousands.
וְזֶהוּ בִּזְמַן שֶׁיִּשְׂרָאֵל עוֹשִׂין רְצוֹנוֹ שֶׁל מָקוֹם,
And this applies when Israel perform the will of the Omnipresent,
דְּנֶאֱמַר: "יְהוּדָה וְיִשְׂרָאֵל רַבִּים... וְלֹא יִסָּפֵר מֵרֹב" (מְלָכִים א ד, כ; ח, ה),
wherein it is said: "Judah and Israel were many... which could not be told nor numbered for multitude",
שֶׁאֵין לָהֶם מִסְפָּר כְּלָל.
having no finite count whatsoever.
אֲבָל כְּשֶׁאֵין עוֹשִׂין רְצוֹנוֹ שֶׁל מָקוֹם,
However, when they do not fulfill the will of the Omnipresent,
נֶאֱמַר: "וְהָיָה מִסְפַּר בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְגוֹמֵר" (הוֹשֵׁעַ ב, א),
it is stated: "Yet the number of the children of Israel shall be, etc.",
שֶׁיֵּשׁ לָהֶם מִסְפָּר, כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה (יוֹמָא כב:);
signifying that they are subject to a fixed count, as our Sages noted (Yoma 22b);
וְאָז הַמִּסְפָּר בִּפְרָטוּת הַכֹּל הֵם נ' פַּעַם שִׁשִּׁים רִבּוֹא,
and then the count including all details totals fifty times sixty myriad,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁהָיוּ בְּגָלוּת מִצְרַיִם שֶׁלֹּא עָשׂוּ רְצוֹנוֹ שֶׁל מָקוֹם.
just as they were in the Egyptian exile when they did not fulfill the will of the Omnipresent.
כִּי שִׁשִּׁים רִבּוֹא הוּא מִסְפַּר הַפָּחוֹת מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל,
For sixty myriad is the baseline minimum number of Israel,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג, רעג:):
as our Sages stated (Zohar Part III, 273b):
אֵין דּוֹר פָּחוֹת מִשִּׁשִּׁים רִבּוֹא;
no generation consists of fewer than sixty myriad;
וְכֵן אָמְרוּ בִּבְרָכוֹת (נח.): "אֵין אוּכְלוּסָא פְּחוּתָה מִשִּׁשִּׁים רִבּוֹא";
and so they said in Berakhot (58a): "there is no full populace (okhlasa) fewer than sixty myriad";
וּבְצֵירוּף הָרְשָׁעִים הֵם עַל כָּל פָּנִים נ' פַּעַם;
and including the wicked they total in all cases fifty times that number;
וּלְפִי שֶׁאָז הָיָה הַבֵּירוּר גַּם עַל הָרְשָׁעִים
and because on Purim the clarification extended even over the sinners,
וְנֶגְדָּם הָיָה טַעֲנַת הָמָן,
and against them was leveled Haman's prosecutorial claim,
עַל כֵּן נָתַן עֲשֶׂרֶת אֲלָפִים כִּכַּר שֶׁל חוֹל,
therefore he offered ten thousand secular talents of silver,
שֶׁהוּא נ' פַּעַם שִׁשִּׁים רִבּוֹא חֲצָאֵי שְׁקָלִים,
which equals fifty times sixty myriad half-shekels,
שֶׁהַתּוֹרָה קְרָאַתּוּ "כֹּפֶר נֶפֶשׁ" (שְׁמוֹת ל, יב).
which the Torah designates as "the ransom of his soul" (Exodus 30:12).
וַחֲכָמֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה אָמְרוּ (יְרוּשַׁלְמִי שְׁקָלִים פֶּרֶק א הֲלָכָה ד, ה.):
And our Sages of blessed memory said (Yerushalmi Shekalim 1:4, 5a):
דְּנִתְקַשָּׁה מֹשֶׁה עַד שֶׁהֶרְאָה לוֹ מַטְבֵּעַ שֶׁל אֵשׁ;
that Moses found it difficult until God showed him a coin of fire;
וְקֹשִׁי זֶה אֵין מוּבָן כִּפְשָׁטוֹ
and this difficulty is not understood in its simple literal sense
(עַיֵּין תּוֹסָפוֹת מְנָחוֹת כט. דִּבּוּר הַמַּתְחִיל "שְׁלֹשָׁה" וּבְחֵלֶק א').
(see Tosafot, Menachot 29a, s.v. "Sheloshah", and in Part I).
וּבָרוּר דְּעִנְיַן הַהִתְקַשּׁוּת הוּא:
And it is clear that the core difficulty was:
אֵיךְ יִהְיֶה "כֹּפֶר נֶפֶשׁ אִישׁ עָשְׁרוֹ" (מִשְׁלֵי יג, ח)
how could "the ransom of a man's soul be his wealth" (Proverbs 13:8),
שֶׁהוּא עִנְיָן שֶׁחוּץ לַגּוּף לְגַמְרֵי,
which is an external matter entirely outside the body,
כִּי "לֹא בְמוֹתוֹ יִקַּח הַכֹּל" (תְּהִלִּים מט, יח),
for "when he dies he shall carry nothing away",
וְאֵין לוֹ שׁוּם שַׁיָּיכוּת לְעֶצֶם הָאָדָם?!
and money has no intrinsic connection to the essence of the human being?!
וַחֲכָמֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה אָמְרוּ (מוֹעֵד קָטָן כח.):
And our Sages of blessed memory stated (Moed Katan 28a):
בָּנֵי, חַיֵּי וּמְזוֹנֵי – לָאו בִּזְכוּתָא תַּלְיָא מִלְּתָא אֶלָּא בְּמַזָּלָא;
children, life, and sustenance do not depend upon merit, but upon mazal (celestial fortune);
כִּי אֵלּוּ ג' הוּא כְּלַל צָרְכֵי הָאָדָם בָּעוֹלָם הַזֶּה,
for these three comprise the entirety of human needs in this world,
וּשְׂכַר מִצְוָה בְּהַאי עָלְמָא לֵיכָּא (קִדּוּשִׁין לט:),
and the true reward of a mitzvah does not exist in this world,
וְדָבָר זֶה נִגְזַר בִּתְחִלַּת הַיְצִירָה:
and this decree is fixed at the dawn of human formation:
"חָכָם אוֹ טִפֵּשׁ" (נִדָּה טז:),
whether one will be "wise or foolish" (Niddah 16b),
וְ"הַחָכְמָה תְּחַיֶּה בְעָלֶיהָ" (קֹהֶלֶת ז, יב) – מִמֶּנּוּ נִמְשָׁךְ חַיֵּי;
and "wisdom gives life to them that have it"—from this is drawn life (chayei);
"גִּבּוֹר אוֹ חַלָּשׁ" – מִזֶּה נִמְשָׁךְ בָּנֵי,
whether "mighty or weak"—from this is drawn children (banei),
"כְּחִצִּים בְּיַד גִּבּוֹר כֵּן בְּנֵי הַנְּעוּרִים" (תְּהִלִּים קכז, ד),
as in "As arrows in the hand of a mighty man, so are the children of youth",
דּוֹרְכֵי קֶשֶׁת וּמַרְבִּים בָּנִים;
bending the bow and multiplying progeny;

whether "rich or poor"—this is the influx of sustenance (mezonei);

as it is written: "that your days may be multiplied, and the days of your children, etc."—behold life and children;

and "I will give your rains, etc."—behold sustenance.

For in truth all these hold direct relevance to Torah and mitzvot:

and having his livelihood ready so that he is not distracted,

for "the reward of a mitzvah is a mitzvah",

and "he who comes to purify himself is aided" with every form of assistance;

and Heaven channels to him an influx of children, life, and sustenance needed to support divine service,

and all the more so children to fulfill the mitzvah of procreation.

that we should not have a son or disciple who oversalts his dish in public (strays), etc.;

wherefore from him descended the royal lineage of the Messiah.

for vegetation possesses at least a botanical vegetative soul,
וְעַל כֵּן הוּא רָאוּי לְמַאֲכַל אָדָם שֶׁמִּתְהַפֵּךְ לְדָם
wherefore it is fit for human food, turning into blood—
הוּא הַנֶּפֶשׁ שֶׁבָּאָדָם;
which constitutes the nephesh within man;
אֲבָל הַדּוֹמֵם אֵין לוֹ שׁוּם שַׁיָּיכוּת לְחַיּוּת הָאָדָם,
yet inanimate metal has no intrinsic connection to man's life-force,
רַק הוּא כְּמוֹ לְבוּשׁ לָאָדָם,
being merely like an external garment to man,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתַבְתִּי לְמַעְלָה עַל פָּסוּק: "וּמָרְדֳּכַי יָצָא בִּלְבוּשׁ וְגוֹמֵר" (אֶסְתֵּר ח, טו),
as I wrote above on the verse: "And Mordechai went forth in royal apparel, etc.",
וּכְמַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב (עֵירוּבִין פו.):
and as written in Eruvin (86a):
"רַבִּי מְכַבֵּד עֲשִׁירִים",
Rabbi Yehudah HaNasi honored the wealthy,
שֶׁהַכָּבוֹד הוּא מִצַּד הַלְּבוּשׁ,
because honor derives from outward garments,
כְּמַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב: "מָאנֵי מְכַבְּדוּתָא" (שַׁבָּת קיג:);
as written: "garments that honor me" (Shabbat 113b);
כִּי הַכָּבוֹד הוּא מֵאֲחֵרִים,
for honor comes from others,
וְהָאֲחֵרִים אֵין מַכִּירִים אֶלָּא הַלְּבוּשׁ וְלֹא הַפְּנִימִיּוּת,
and others perceive only the garment and not the interior,
דְּ"הָאָדָם יִרְאֶה לַעֵינַיִם" (שְׁמוּאֵל א טז, ז).
for "man looks on the outward appearance".
וְעַל כֵּן נֶאֱמַר: "מְלֹא כָל הָאָרֶץ כְּבוֹדוֹ" (יְשַׁעְיָה ו, ג),
Therefore it is stated: "the whole earth is full of His glory",
דְּ"הָאָרֶץ" הוּא עוֹלָם הַזֶּה שֶׁאֵין הַהִתְגַּלּוּת אֶלָּא דֶּרֶךְ לְבוּשִׁים
for 'the earth' is this physical world wherein revelation occurs strictly via garments—
הוּא רַק כְּבוֹדוֹ;
which is merely His manifest glory;
וְ"לֹא יִרְאַנִי הָאָדָם וָחָי" (שְׁמוֹת לג, כ),
and "man shall not see Me and live",
דְּאִי אֶפְשָׁר לְהִתְגַּלּוֹת עֶצֶם בָּעוֹלָם הַזֶּה כְּלָל.
for the transcendent divine Essence cannot be unveiled in this world at all.
וְכֵן יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּעוֹלָם הַזֶּה: "רָזוֹהִי כַּסְיָין" (שַׁבָּת קנו.),
And likewise Israel in this world: "their secrets are concealed",
דְּאֵין הָעֶצֶם נִגְלֶה רַק הַלְּבוּשִׁים;
in that their essence is not exposed, but only the outward garments;
כִּי עֶצֶם יִשְׂרָאֵל דָּבוּק בַּהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ,
for the essence of Israel cleaves unto Hashem, blessed be He,
וְכָל הַטַּעֲנוֹת שֶׁעֲלֵיהֶם הוּא מִצַּד הַלְּבוּשִׁים,
and all prosecutorial claims against them stem merely from their outward garments,
כְּמַה שֶּׁכָּתַבְתִּי לְמַעְלָה דְּהִמְשִׁילוּ חֲכָמֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה (סַנְהֶדְרִין מד.): "לְאָסָא דְּקָאֵי בֵּינֵי הִיזְמֵי".
as I wrote above, that our Sages compared an Israelite to a myrtle standing among briars.
וְצֹרֶךְ כֹּפֶר נֶפֶשׁ הוּא רַק מִצַּד הַחֵטְא;
And the necessity of a soul-ransom arises strictly from sin;
וְעַל כֵּן אָז, הֲגַם שֶׁהָיוּ כֻּלָּם נְקִיִּים בְּעֵת הַמִּסְפָּר,
and therefore then, even though they were all pure at the time of the census,
הוּצְרְכוּ לְכֹפֶר נֶפֶשׁ: "וְלֹא יִהְיֶה בָהֶם נֶגֶף בִּפְקֹד אֹתָם" (שְׁמוֹת ל, יב);
they required a ransom of the soul: "that there be no plague among them when you number them";
כִּי כָּל מִסְפָּר הוּא מִצַּד שֶׁאֵין עוֹשִׂין רְצוֹנוֹ שֶׁל מָקוֹם,
for every numbering reflects the state where they do not fully perform the will of the Omnipresent,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה (יוֹמָא כב:);
as our Sages of blessed memory noted (Yoma 22b);
וְאַף דְּדוֹר מְקַבְּלֵי הַתּוֹרָה הָיוּ אָז בְּתַכְלִית הַקְּדוּשָּׁה,
and even though the generation of the recipients of the Torah stood then in ultimate holiness,
מִכָּל מָקוֹם מַה שֶּׁלֹּא הָיוּ בְּתַכְלִית הָרִיבּוּי
nonetheless, the fact that they were not in infinite multitude
גַּם כֵּן הָיָה מִצַּד שֶׁהָיָה בָּהֶם רְשָׁעִים וּמֵתוּ בִּימֵי אֲפֵלָה;
was likewise because there were wicked among them who died during the days of darkness;
וַהֲרֵי כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל גּוֹי אֶחָד,
and behold all Israel are one single nation,
וְחִסָּרוֹן שֶׁל רְשָׁעִים הוּא נוֹגֵעַ גַּם לָאֵלּוּ;
and the deficiency of the wicked touches even these righteous souls;
וְכָל מִסְפָּר הָיָה אַחַר חֵטְא,
and every census took place following a sin,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה (בְּמִדְבַּר רַבָּה פָּרָשָׁה כא, ז): "מָשָׁל לִזְאֵב וְכוּלֵי";
as our Sages stated (Bemidbar Rabbah 21:7): "a parable of a wolf entering the flock, etc.";
וְעַל כֵּן, אַף דְּהַנִּשְׁאָרִים לֹא חָטְאוּ,
and therefore, even though the survivors did not personally sin,
מִכָּל מָקוֹם מִצַּד הַמִּסְפָּר,
nevertheless from the perspective of the count,
שֶׁזֶּה מוֹרֶה שֶׁנֶּחְסַר מֵהֶם עַל יְדֵי הַחֵטְא,
which demonstrates that their number was diminished through sin,
הִנֵּה זֶה מוֹרֶה חִסָּרוֹן גַּם בָּהֶם,
behold, this indicates a deficiency touching them as well,
שֶׁהֲרֵי הָיוּ מְחוּבָּרִים עִמָּהֶם לִהְיוֹת אֶחָד מַמָּשׁ.
for they were joined with them to be literally one unified body.
וְכֵן זֶהוּ תִּיקּוּנָם שֶׁל רְשָׁעִים,
And likewise this is the rectification of the wicked,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה (כְּרֵיתוֹת ו:):
as our Sages of blessed memory noted (Keritot 6b):
עַל חֶלְבְּנָה שֶׁנִּצְטָרֵף עִם סַמְמָנֵי הַקְּטֹרֶת,
concerning the foul-smelling galbanum combined with the sweet spices of the incense,
וְעַל עֲרָבָה שֶׁהִיא בַּאֲגוּדָּה אַחַת עִם הַלּוּלָב
and concerning the willow bound in one bundle with the lulav (Vayikra Rabbah 30:12),
וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה נִתְקַן הַכֹּל
and through this everything is rectified
(עַיֵּין רַבֵּינוּ בַּחְיֵי פָּרָשַׁת כִּי תִשָּׂא);
(see Rabbeinu Bachya, Parashat Ki Tisa);
וְעַל כֵּן הוּצְרְכוּ לְכֹפֶר נֶפֶשׁ
wherefore they required a soul-ransom—
מַחֲצִית הַשֶּׁקֶל שֶׁהוּא מַטְבֵּעַ הַיּוֹצֵאת.
the half-shekel, which is the standard circulating coin.
וּכְלַל רְכוּשׁ דְּעֹשֶׁר הוּא מַטְבֵּעַ הַיּוֹצֵא,
And the collective substance of wealth is the circulating currency,
שֶׁבּוֹ יוּכְלוּ לְהַשִּׂיג כָּל צָרְכֵי אָדָם בָּעוֹלָם הַזֶּה;
through which one can procure all human needs in this physical world;
וְנוֹתֵן מַחֲצִית,
and each brings a half,
עַל דֶּרֶךְ שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר (פְּסָחִים סח:):
in the manner stated (Pesachim 68b):
בְּיוֹם טוֹב – "חֶצְיוֹ לַה' וְחֶצְיוֹ לָכֶם";
on a festival—"half for Hashem and half for yourselves";
כִּי יוֹם טוֹב הוּא קְדוּשַׁת יִשְׂרָאֵל דִּמְקַדְּשֵׁי לִזְמַנִּים,
for a festival embodies the sanctity of Israel who sanctify the seasons,
דְּהַיְינוּ עִנְיְנֵי עוֹלָם הַזֶּה שֶׁהוּא תַּחַת הַזְּמַן,
namely the affairs of this world which exist under time,
וְנִיתַּן רְשׁוּת לֵיהָנוֹת מֵעוֹלָם הַזֶּה
and permission is granted to enjoy this world,
וְהַכֹּל קָדוֹשׁ לַה';
while everything remains holy unto Hashem;
עַל דֶּרֶךְ שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר בִּבְרָכוֹת (לה.):
along the lines of what is stated in Berakhot (35a):
דְּאַחַר בְּרָכָה: "וְהָאָרֶץ נָתַן לִבְנֵי אָדָם" (תְּהִלִּים קטו, טז),
that after reciting a blessing: "the earth has He given to the children of men",
וְאֵינוֹ עוֹד מוֹעֵל בְּקָדְשֵׁי שָׁמַיִם,
and he is no longer committing sacrilege against the holy things of Heaven,
כֵּיוָן שֶׁמַּכִּיר שֶׁהַכֹּל מֵהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ וְהוּא הַנּוֹתֵן;
since he acknowledges that all is from Hashem, blessed be He, Who bestows it;
וְזֶה הוּא אֲכִילַת חוֹל דִּרְשׁוּת וְאֵינוֹ מוֹעֵל.
and this is weekday eating which is permissible without sacrilege.
וּבְיוֹם טוֹב שֶׁהוּא הַשָּׂגַת קְדוּשָּׁה בָּעוֹלָם הַזֶּה,
And on a festival, which is the attainment of holiness within this world,
הָאֲכִילָה הוּא עוֹד מִצְוָה;
eating is furthermore an actual mitzvah;
וּמִכָּל מָקוֹם צָרִיךְ "חֶצְיוֹ לַה'",
and nonetheless it requires "half for Hashem",
כְּדֶרֶךְ שֶׁאִיתָא בְּפֶרֶק רַבִּי עֲקִיבָא (שַׁבָּת פט:):
in the manner taught in chapter Rabbi Akiva (Shabbat 89b):
דְּאָמַר יִצְחָק: "פַּלְגָא עָלַי וּפַלְגָא עֲלָךְ,
where Isaac pleaded: "half is upon me and half upon You;
וְכִי תֵּימָא כֻּלָּא עָלַי – הָא קָרִיבִית נַפְשִׁי קַמָּךְ";
and if You say all is upon me—behold I offered my soul before You";
וְהַכַּוָּנָה: דְּעַל יְדֵי הַקְרָבַת נֶפֶשׁ,
and the inner intent is: through the offering of his soul,
שֶׁמָּסַר עַצְמוֹ כֻּלּוֹ לַהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ
surrendering his entire being unto Hashem, blessed be He,
וְנַעֲשָׂה עוֹלָה תְּמִימָה כֻּלּוֹ לַה',
becoming an unblemished burnt-offering entirely unto Hashem,
הֲרֵי נִתְיַיחֵד בְּשָׁרְשׁוֹ בְּלֹא דָּבָר הַחוֹצֵץ.
behold he united with his divine root without any barrier.
וַהֲרֵי זֶה עַל דֶּרֶךְ יִחוּד אִישׁ וְאִשְׁתּוֹ: "וְהָיוּ לְבָשָׂר אֶחָד",
And this mirrors the union of husband and wife: "and they shall be one flesh",
דְּכָל אֶחָד פְּלַג גּוּף,
each being half a body,
וְשׁוֹלְטִין בְּנִכְסֵיהוֹן שָׁוֶה בְּשָׁוֶה כְּאוֹרַח כָּל אַרְעָא;
and exercising equal shared control over their possessions according to worldly custom;
וּכְמַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב אֲחַשְׁוֵרוֹשׁ לְאֶסְתֵּר: "עַד חֲצִי הַמַּלְכוּת וְתֵעָשׂ" (אֶסְתֵּר ה, ג),
and as written of Ahasuerus to Esther: "even to half of the kingdom, it shall be granted",
וְלֹא יוֹתֵר, לִהְיוֹת שָׁוֶה לוֹ.
and not more, so that she be equal with him.
וְכֵן הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא וּכְנֶסֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל,
And so too the Holy One, blessed be He, and the Congregation of Israel,
כַּאֲשֶׁר הֵם דְּבוּקִים בּוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ,
when they cleave unto Him, blessed be He,
הָעוֹלָם הַזֶּה חָלוּק: "חֶצְיוֹ לַה' וְחֶצְיוֹ לָכֶם";
this physical world divides: "half for Hashem and half for you";
וְהוּא בְּיוֹם טוֹב שֶׁזּוֹכִין לִרְאִיַּת פָּנִים בָּעֲזָרָה,
and this manifests on a festival when they merit appearing before His face in the Temple courtyard,
שֶׁאָז הוּא מִצַּד הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ – נוֹתֵן "חֶצְיוֹ לָכֶם".
where from Hashem's side He grants "half for you."

And the half-shekel operates conversely:
מִצַּד יִשְׂרָאֵל – נוֹתְנִין "חֲצִי לַה'";
from the side of Israel—they dedicate "half unto Hashem";
וְזֶהוּ כֹּפֶר הַחֲטָאִים שֶׁמִּצַּד הַלְּבוּשִׁים,
and this is the ransom for sins which cling to outward garments,

in that they acknowledge that their very garments likewise derive from Hashem.

And even after reciting a blessing whereby "the earth has He given to the children of men",

nonetheless Israel's physical enjoyment in this world is not an alienated, secular phenomenon,

for all their eating is directed to gain strength for the service of Hashem and the like;
